text: I don’t know how to give him up! He was such a comfort to me, although he tormented my old heart out of me, ’most.” “The Lord giveth and the Lord hath taken away—Blessed be the name of the Lord! But it’s so hard—Oh, it’s so hard! Only last Saturday my Joe busted a firecracker right under my nose and I knocked him sprawling. Little did I know then, how soon—Oh, if it was to do over again I’d hug him and bless him for it.” “Yes, yes, yes, I know just how you feel, Mrs. Harper, I know just exactly how you feel.
